title: Fix inconsistent CLEAN27/CLEAN28 tags in E-Document apps
summary: E-Document apps now use consistent CLEAN27 and CLEAN28 tags so each cleanup step can be removed independently, fixing compilation failures when only CLEAN27 was applied.
key_points: Moved references to 'EDoc Historical Matching Setup' from CLEAN28 to CLEAN27 guards since the table is removed in CLEAN27
Updated Continia registration tests to use correct permission sets after 'E-Doc. Core - Edit' deletion in CLEAN27
Added CLEAN27 guard to obsolete interface 'IPurchaseLineAccountProvider' to enable its future removal
Reclassified 'E-Documents Setup' table as Removed in CLEAN28 and guarded its procedures
Kept Purchase Header E-Document Link cleanup unguarded since import process version 1.0 is still supported
quote: aligns the tags so each CLEAN step can be removed on its own
